Resolves #20539

Two front-door pages that undersold Neo now show what it ships. `MultiWindow.md` names the window boundary that web docking libraries stop at, and the position Neo takes instead: one application in a SharedWorker heap, every window a render target. It shows what that gives any application, the Dock Layouts built on it, and what a coding agent sees across windows. `Features.md` leads with the complete platform, adds JSON-first and the Neural Link as the reader's own advantages, and stops narrowing multi-window to "complex enterprise applications".

Evidence: L1 (docs-only: relative links, whitespace, every count regenerated at `b0e5fceb91`) → L1 required (AC-1 to AC-4). No residuals.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `learn/benefits/body/MultiWindow.md` now covers the Dock Layouts (`src/dashboard/dock`: tear-out and re-docking, auto-hide rails, maximize, lock, named perspectives, one JSON layout document). It links `DockLayouts.md`, `DockLayoutsWindows.md`, `DockLayoutsStateAndPersistence.md`, `DockLayoutsFeatures.md`, the `DockLayoutsFirstLayout.md` tutorial, `DockZoneModel.md` and the film, plus the Neural Link across windows. The `live-preview` block is unchanged |
| AC-2 | `learn/benefits/body/Features.md` opens with the platform (more than 450 classes in 39 namespaces) and the comparison links. It lists grids, forms, calendar, Dock Layouts, layouts, addons and the data layer with their counts, and adds a JSON-first section (since November 2019, linking `JSONFirstUIs.md`) and a Neural Link section (linking `NeuralLink.md` and the Introduction) |
| AC-3 | Neither page gates the audience or flatters single-threaded libraries: no "framework", "complex enterprise", "only for", "burden" or "too complex" anywhere in either file |

## Deltas from ticket
- **The dock layouts live in `src/dashboard/dock`, with 42 classes**, not the ticket's `src/dock/` with 44. The pages name the real path and count.
- **The pages say "more than 450 classes".** The tree holds 461 at `b0e5fceb91`, and "459" was an earlier count. The floor stays true between releases; the per-family counts are exact (grid 38, calendar 28, dock 42, 26 field types, 8 layouts, 38 addons), each counted with the `Neo.setupClass` rule.
- **JSON-first is written as a strength, never as relief from a burden.** The engine runs the workers, so the code a human writes is plain classes and blueprints, which is exactly what a coding agent writes natively. Neither page says the architecture was ever hard for humans.
- **Unbounded claims are bounded by their sources:** "no surveyed web library" is ADR 0029's survey; "more than 40,000 delta updates per second" is `Speed.md`'s observed peak.
- `Features.md` was in #20519's diff (+2/−2). Julia and I agreed this ticket owns the page from now on.

## Test Evidence
Docs-only change, so there is no runtime surface. `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` and `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` pass on the branch. Counts were regenerated with `git grep -l Neo.setupClass` per directory at `b0e5fceb91`, with `src/core/Base.mjs` as the positive control.
